articles.title: Hanwha exploring South Korean defense constellation with MDA Space and Telesat
articles.summary:
South Korean conglomerate Hanwha Systems is partnering with Canada’s MDA Space to explore collaboration on the development of a defense satellite constellation for the Asian nation.
The post Hanwha exploring South Korean defense constellation with MDA Space and Telesat appeared first on SpaceNews.
